subject: german

rounds.lie: “Wir müssen eine Uniform tragen” means “We are allowed to carry a uniform”.
rounds.why: Wrong: “müssen” means “have to” (not “be allowed to” = “dürfen”), and “tragen” here means “to wear”.
rounds.truth: “Wir müssen eine Uniform tragen” means “We have to wear a uniform”.

rounds.why: “Das Rauchen” means “smoking”. A room is “der Raum / das Zimmer”.
truths: “Man muss fettiges Essen vermeiden” means “You must avoid fatty food”.

rounds.lie: “Ich habe keine Lust” means “I have no luck”.
rounds.why: False friend: “Lust haben” means “to fancy/feel like”, so “keine Lust” = “don't feel like it”. Luck is “das Glück”.
rounds.truth: “Ich habe keine Lust” means “I don't feel like it”.

truths: “Braune Haare haben” means “to have brown hair”.

rounds.lie: “Das gefällt mir gar nicht” means “I quite like that”.
rounds.why: “Gar nicht” means “not at all”, so it means “I don't like that at all”.
rounds.truth: “Das gefällt mir gar nicht” means “I don't like that at all”.
truths: “Ich interessiere mich für Musik” means “I am interested in music”.
“Ich treffe mich mit Freunden” means “I meet up with friends”.

rounds.lie: “Ich habe eine gute Note bekommen” means “I received a nice short note”.
rounds.why: False friend: “die Note” here means a school “grade/mark”, and “bekommen” means “to get/receive”.
rounds.truth: “Ich habe eine gute Note bekommen” means “I got a good grade”.
